description_en: Adds tags to resources. Instance resources are supported
description_zh: 给资源打标签。当前支持实例 Instance 资源
kebab_example: aliyun cr tag-resources --resource-type Instance --resource-id cri-1lg7vtctpqdn0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tag Value=test-val Key=test-key --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en: The type of the resource. Instance resources are supported
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型。当前支持实例Instance资源
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The resource IDs. You can specify a maximum of 20 resource IDs
parameters.help_zh: 资源 ID。最多支持添加20个资源
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resources
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with acs: or aliyun, and cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

A tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with acs: or aliyun, and cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: value
